versions.content: Service Name Eth_MacSecUpdateRxSa (draft) Syntax Std_ReturnType Eth_MacSecUpdateRxSa ( uint8 CtrlIdx, uint8 An, uint64 LowestPn, boolean Active ) Service ID [hex] 0x31 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different CtrlIdx, non reentrant for the same CtrlIdx CtrlIdx Index of the Ethernet controller within the context of Ethernet Driver An Association Number to use in the MACsec’s reception secure association LowestPn Next accepted Packet Number in the MACsec’s reception secure association Parameters (in) Active Boolean to enable/disable the MACsec’s reception secure association Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK : The request has been accecpted E_NOT_OK : The request has been rejected Description Requests the Ethernet Controller Driver to update the Reception Secure Association with the given Packet Number. The Active parameter is included to change the specified AN status. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via Eth.h
